rule: Entries whose complete taxon string is exactly a genus followed by 'sp.' are not species-level taxa and are excluded from the active botanical taxon universe while preserving their historical source/provenance record.

scope_guard.other_abbreviations: Interpret botanically before any action; if meaning is uncertain, preserve as unresolved and do not infer.

user_clarification: gr. means grupo and must not be treated as sp.; official group determinations are retained.
historical_record_policy: COPY_NEVER_MOVE; exclusion from active processing does not delete original evidence.
downstream_policy: No species-level STIME score may remain current for an excluded placeholder.
